From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@kilntech.com>

Date: 2027-03-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SIG/CAIQ intake and availability for KilnTech evaluation

Hi Grace,

I'm Elena from KilnTech's procurement/security team — we're evaluating Redwood for a pilot and need to run through the standard SIG/CAIQ intake and a short evidence review. Can we book a 45-minute session next week to walk through the questionnaire and handoff artifacts?

Quick context: we're a mid-market industrial SaaS provider starting a POC for an LLM-assisted support feature; security is the gating item. Our security lead (copied below on next mails once we confirm) will join.

Would you be available any of these windows:
- Tue 2027-03-23, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 2027-03-24, 13:00–14:00 PT
- Thu 2027-03-25, 09:00–10:00 PT

I've attached a short intake workbook to show the initial scope. On the call we typically ask for: SOC 2 Type II (if available), network diagram for the SaaS endpoint, sample logs for a recent 7-day window, and any data residency statements.

Attachment: KilnTech_SIG_Request_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Thanks — Elena
Elena Morales
Senior Procurement Manager, KilnTech
elena.morales@kilntech.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@kilntech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-22T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG/CAIQ intake and availability for KilnTech evaluation

Hi Elena — thanks for reaching out and the workbook. Happy to set this up and walk through the SIG items. Marissa (security lead on onboarding/evidence) and David (platform/logging owner) are looped in for the call and follow-up.

We can do a 45-minute deep-dive. Proposed times (PT):
- Tue 2027-03-23, 10:00–10:45 (works for us)
- Wed 2027-03-24, 13:00–13:45

If the 23rd works let's lock it. For the agenda, we'll cover:
1) Quick intros and scope (5 min)
2) Walk SIG/CAIQ workbook and clarifying Qs (20–25 min)
3) Evidence handoff expectations and sample artifacts required (10 min)
4) Next steps and owner assignments (5–10 min)

Requested artifacts ahead of time (so we can triage before the call):
- SOC 2 Type II report or attestation (Marissa will coordinate permissions)
- Example logs for a 7-day window (David will prepare a sanitized sample)
- Network topology / SaaS connectivity diagram
- CAIQ/SIG workbook completed where possible (we'll review during the call)

I can host the call on Redwood Zoom; if KilnTech prefers Teams let us know.

Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Security, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: NW-evidence-inventory-template.xlsx (empty template we will use on the call)

Thanks Grace — the 23rd at 10:00 PT works for our side. Joining from KilnTech: myself (procurement lead), Samir Patel (Security Lead, samir.patel@kilntech.com) and a member of our operations team. We'll plan for Zoom.

I've attached an updated SIG workbook with a few clarifying fields filled in on our side. On the call we would appreciate:
- quick note on where Redwood hosts logs and what sample exports look like
- a rough retention/archival breakdown (hot vs cold) for tokenized request data and logs
- confirmation of private deployment options and whether any data would transit outside our requested regions

We also need a place to drop evidence post-call — could you share a link (secure SharePoint/Box/Drive) or a short-lived upload link?

Attachment: KilnTech_SIG_Questions_v2.xlsx

Doc links: https://kilntech.atlassian.net/browse/KILN-SEC-442 (for internal ref)

See you Tuesday.

—Elena
